name: Bulbous Blood Ooze
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

skills.name: stealth
note: if hiding inside a dead body 14

generalAbilities.name: Infuse Corpse
generalAbilities.description: A blood ooze can seep into a corpse's wounds, displacing its natural blood. It can burst out of the corpse as a free action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Blood Pool
defensiveAbilities.description: Whenever a creature adjacent to a blood ooze takes bleed damage, the blood ooze regains an amount of Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.

defensiveAbilities.name: Clot
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The blood ooze is damaged by a piercing or slashing attack

Effect The blood ooze forms a clot around the wound, reducing the damage taken by 5 (to a minimum of 0).

offensiveAbilities.name: Siphon Vitality
offensiveAbilities.description: The blood ooze draws forth blood from nearby creatures, causing their flesh to break open and blood to spill out, which replenishes the blood ooze. Each living creature within 15 feet takes 4d6 Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save). The blood ooze regains an amount of Hit Points equal to half the damage Siphon Vitality dealt to the single creature that took the most damage.
